question: How many percent of female heroes were published by Marvel Comics?
evidence: percent = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender = 'Female' WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'), COUNT(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')), 100); female heroes refers to gender = 'Female'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching publisher record.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 LEFT JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T3.gender = 'Female'
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T3.gender = 'Female'

c.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

b.request: Among all heroes, including those with no matching publisher record, what percentage are female and published by Marvel Comics?
b.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
b.raw: Among all heroes, including those with no matching publisher record, what percentage are female and published by Marvel Comics?

d.request: What percentage of female heroes were published by Marvel Comics, counting all heroes with Marvel Comics as publisher and also keeping heroes that have no matching publisher record?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero s INNER JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
